title: soap action
description: Calls a SOAP 1.1 web service: the body, the payload of the operation, goes in a SOAP envelope in a POST to the address of the step, and the response replaces the body (with extract, only the first element of the SOAP body). With smart, the WSDL gives the namespace of the payload and the SOAPAction of the operation.

path.title: Address
path.description: From the URI: http(s)://<host>[:<port>]/<path>, the address of the service

action.title: SOAP action
action.description: The operation, such as GetPhoneTypes; default the name of the first element of the body. With smart the WSDL tells its SOAPAction, else this is the SOAPAction header

extract.title: Extract
extract.description: Replace the body with the first element of the SOAP body of the response, after an XML declaration, instead of the whole response; a SOAP fault fails the message

smart.title: Smart
smart.description: Read the WSDL (once; the address with ?wsdl) to give the payload the namespace of the operation, when it has none, and to find its SOAPAction

params.title: Parameters
params.description: wsdl (any case): the query that fetches the WSDL, ?wsdl by default. Anything else, such as a=1&b=2, is added to the address of every call

headers.title: SOAP headers
headers.description: JSON array of header elements for the SOAP envelope: [{"name": "Token", "value": "text", "attrs": [{"name": "User", "value": "me"}]}]. An attribute without a value is left out. With smart they get the namespace of the operation

httpHeaders.title: HTTP headers
httpHeaders.description: JSON array of HTTP headers to send: [{"name": "ApiToken", "value": "123"}]

auth.title: Basic credentials
auth.description: Base64 of user:password, sent as Authorization: Basic

token.title: Token
token.description: Sent as Authorization: Bearer, unless auth is set

trustStoreFile.title: Trust store
trustStoreFile.description: PKCS#12 keystore with the certificates to trust for https; "" trusts the system's roots

trustStorePassword.title: Trust store password
trustStorePassword.description: Trust store password; env DIF_TRUSTSTORE_PASSWORD (or its _FILE companion)

socketTimeout.title: Timeout
socketTimeout.description: Milliseconds a call, and the fetch of the WSDL, may take

connectTimeout.title: Connect timeout
connectTimeout.description: Milliseconds the connection may take to set up
